entries.back_en: Since the beginning of the world, we have preserved the secrets of the Spell of Evocation, the knowledge of how to summon gods.
Part of what you all said we already know... What we want to know is, what should we do now?
B-but, ! You mean you're going to trad
entries.note: 'troca' truncated; source ends 'trade [04]' so should be 'trocar'.

entries.back_en: We have kept this village's existence secret as much as possible, fearing others would come and use our knowledge for the wrong purposes.
Some people say that if we hadn't summoned the gods here, the world would have been destroyed.
You mean that [04][05] is also a...a god?
Hello. The Abbess told me what happened. I'll help you the best I can.
Humph! I was hoping for a better body than this. Well, I suppose it'll have to do.

Hey, wait a minute! I was stuck in that armor for an eternity! I'd like to relax for a while, OK? How about giving me something to eat and drink? Is this how you treat such an important guest? Where are your manners?
... Look, you wanted to talk to a god, right? If you ask me, it comes with the territory. Every god needs an offering or two, right? ...burp!
entries.note: 'eructo' too formal for casual Deis (use 'arroto'); 'vem com o território' awkward literalism.

entries.back_en: We are summoned... Summoned from other worlds...And brought here. But do you know why we are summoned? Well, do you, kitty?
... We were summoned by the Fou Empire.
The Empire knows the Spell of Evocation?
Not exactly... The Empire developed its own method of summoning. That's how [04]
entries.note: Faithful; stray backslash before 'seu' is cosmetic.

entries.back_en: I wasn't able to manifest completely and got stuck in that armor.
As for [04]
Split into two? What does that mean?
You mean there's another [04]
Yes... But [04]
But even if [04]
He's dead, right? I mean, centuries have passed...
Not necessarily... If he is also one of the Endless, he wouldn't die easily, and certainly not simply by the passing of years.
entries.note: 'um dos Os Eternos' ungrammatical; should be 'um dos Eternos'.

entries.back_en: So...Where can we find him?
I don't know how to explain it well, but... The reason I'm here with [04]
I heard Rhem is channeling the spirit of a god. Is it true?
By the way, you can keep calling me [04][05] if you want, but my real name is Deis.
I had forgotten... [04][05] is no longer inside me.
Thank goodness you're awake!
Ha ha ha ha! It appears we have been discovered.
Hmmmm...Since [04][05] is no longer here, I find myself at a loss. I'm unsure what I should do.
However... I'd be willing to forget everything if... If you tell me where to find your dragon friend.
It would be prudent not to tell you that. That is what [04][05] says.
He's used up almost all his power reserves... That's what he gets for trying to show off!
Well, if I went back inside him, that would give him enough energy to move again... But there's no way you're getting me back in there! I've had enough of being trapped in that tin can!
I... I am but a suit of armor... I received my power from [04][05]... I am glad... I had the chance to live.
Ha ha ha... Thank you, [04][05]. Ha ha...Ha ha ha ha ...... Was that... an appropriate time to laugh?
They hate each other... They kill one another... They do horrible things to themselves and their fellow beings without a second thought...
And yet... They feel compassion and sympathy for this... An animated suit of armor-- something that shouldn't even be alive.
Perhaps... Perhaps it is because we know that it too will pass... It is because everything must come to an end that it can be said to be beautiful.
So...You intend to go to the Empire after all.
Hmmm...It makes sense... An incomplete god wouldn't have full control of his power.
So your plan then is to travel to the Empire, and find the other [04]
We know who he is. We also know that [04][06] is like [04]
Is that so? I don't recall you capturing me. Care to try?
entries.note: 'Isso assim?' is nonsensical; should be 'É mesmo?/Ah é?'.

entries.back_en: I just remembered something. We haven't told Deis yet about what happened.
She's probably sleeping somewhere in the village. You should find her and wake her up.
Mmm... Oh, it's you. Wait just a minute, OK?
There we go. I figured if I'm going with you, it's easier this way.
Don't get the wrong idea! It's not because I enjoy being in this armor or anything!
There's not much I can do by myself anyway... I mean, what good's a god without a body, eh?
Oh... You're awake, eh? I decided to stick around with them a bit longer. That means I'll need you again. Hope you don't mind.
What're you laughing for!? I didn't come back because I wanted to!
Sigh... All right, all right... Enough already. Listen to me--from now on, I want you to call me Deis, OK?
Yes, [04][05]. Why the hell didn't you listen!? Be confusing if we both use that name. You can have it, OK?
entries.note: 'What did I just tell you' mistranslated as 'Por que diabos não escutou'; 'usamao' garbled; meaning altered.

entries.back_en: Great and powerful Yorae Dragon! If you're looking for the Abbess, she is in her quarters.
You too have been caught up in the dragon's path... The life stream of the Endless. I pray the path you walk be a straight one.
Mighty Deis... I see you've chosen to return to [04][05]'s body... Please forgive me if I wasn't worthy of you...
Well I'll be...! You do know! Not bad, my little chickadee.
I could've used a little more sleep, but I guess there's work to be done. Well then, shall we go?
Isn't there anything we can do to help him?
It looks like he's asleep...
